void buildResult(Object l10n) {
  final localizedElsewhere = l10n;
  consume(localizedElsewhere);

  final result = DomainResult(
    message: 'Still hardcoded despite distant localization context.',
  );
  debugPrint('Developer trace detail for support.');
  consume(result);
}

String switchTitle(Object kind) => switch (kind) {
  'symbol' => 'Create a symbol fragment',
  _ => 'Create a fallback fragment',
};

void buildTrace() {
  final bullets = <String>[
    'Read the current tape symbol.',
    'Move the head one position.',
  ];
  final pendingMessage = 'Intermediate user-facing explanation.';
  consume(bullets);
  consume(DomainResult(message: pendingMessage));
}
